question: Tata Iron and steel company (TISCO) began producing steel in ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1912.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **TISCO:-**

 
 
• It began producing steel in **1912, **making it one of the **oldest steel companies **in India.
 
• The company was founded by **Jamsetji Tata** and is now known as** Tata Steel.**
 
• TISCO played a significant role in **India's industrialization and development.**
 
• The company has faced challenges in recent years, including **financial difficulties and environmental controversies.**
